fields.name: title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: Human-readable name of this enemy (e.g. GRUNT, RUNNER). Matches EnemyTypes.NAME in the Godot port.

fields.name: slug
fields.title: Slug
fields.description: Stable machine id for this enemy type. Mirror of the EnemyTypes integer id contract (grunt/runner/elite/tnt/divebomber).

fields.name: family
fields.title: Family
fields.description: Archetype the enemy reads as. grunt/elite map to source ENEMY_STATS; bomber is the suicidal TNT lineage; flyer is the port-local DIVEBOMBER; technobot is the reserved robot lineage.

fields.name: statBlock
fields.title: Stat block
fields.description: Core combat stats, copied 1:1 from EnemyTypes parallel const arrays (HP / DMG / SPEED).

fields.name: baseDamage
fields.title: Base damage
fields.description: Contact damage dealt to the player. EnemyTypes.DMG[type]. For the bomber/flyer families this is the detonation payload.

fields.name: moveSpeed
fields.title: Move speed (units/s)
fields.description: Chase / movement speed in world units per second. EnemyTypes.SPEED[type].

fields.name: behavior
fields.title: Behavior
fields.description: How the enemy closes on the player. swoop = chase then dive (all source flyers can swoop); contact = melee/proximity rush; air-swoop = the hovering bomber's dive-to-detonate.

fields.name: contactBand
fields.title: Contact band
fields.description: Horizontal (XZ) distance band within which contact / attack proximity is judged. Web pursuit zeroes the Y component, so a hovering enemy still reaches a ground player.

fields.name: dropTable
fields.title: Drop table
fields.description: Weighted pickups this enemy can drop on death. Empty for most swarm types in the source port; modeled here for future loot tuning.

fields.name: weight
fields.title: Weight
fields.description: Relative likelihood of this pickup within the drop table.

fields.name: scaling
fields.title: Scaling curve
fields.description: Per-floor HP/damage scaling curve applied to this enemy. The Godot port composes wave/floor scaling on top of the base stat block.
